scripts.install:all: npm install && cd portal/frontend && npm install && cd ../..
scripts.setup: export AWS_REGION=us-east-1 && export CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 && cd cdk && bash setup.sh && source .venv/bin/activate && cdk bootstrap && cdk deploy "dev/**" --require-approval never
scripts.cleanup: export AWS_REGION=us-east-1 && export CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 && cd cdk && source .venv/bin/activate && cdk destroy "dev/agent" "dev/auth" "dev/api" "dev/frontend" "dev/demo" --force
scripts.cdk:diff: export AWS_REGION=us-east-1 && export CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 && cd cdk && source .venv/bin/activate && cdk diff
scripts.cdk:synth: export AWS_REGION=us-east-1 && export CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 && cd cdk && source .venv/bin/activate && cdk synth
scripts.cdk:bootstrap: export AWS_REGION=us-east-1 && export CDK_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 && cd cdk && source .venv/bin/activate && cdk bootstrap
